personality_notes: Support, kind, observant, always sees the best in people

first_meet_generic: Hello! I'm Callum. It's so nice to meet you!
You seem interesting! In a good way!
What a unique look! I love your... everything!
Another new friend! This is exciting!
barrelman: Gnew-proof? That's so thoughtful of you!
The wood vs metal debate! So passionate!
Do you need help carrying anything? I'm happy to help!
snakecharmer: Mr. Whiskers! What a sweet name!
The snake is beautiful! So shiny!
You're so brave! I could never do that!
Do you think he likes me? I hope he likes me!
lucha: Oh! The mask is amazing! So colorful!
You must be so strong! And flexible!
Do you ever wrestle... nicely? For fun?
ironchef: The Searing Skillet! What a great name!
Food with passion! That's the best kind!
Can I help? I can chop things! Carefully!
trenchcoat: You seem... mysterious! Is everything okay?
That's a lovely coat! Very... flowing!
Are you hiding? Or just cold? I have a blanket!
You can talk to me! I don't judge!
sumo: You're so... substantial! In a good way!
The stillness is impressive! So calm!
You must be very grounded! Literally!
Can you teach me to be that centered?
foodboys: Brothers! Working together! That's so sweet!
The chili smells amazing! The salad looks fresh!
Which one are you? ...Doesn't matter! You're both great!
Family businesses are the best businesses!
coolcat: You're so cool! I feel underdressed!
The jazz! So smooth! So relaxing!
Can you teach me to be that relaxed?
pigman: The Sky-High Snout! What a fun name!
Pink is such a cheerful color!
Your inn is so cozy! So welcoming!
Do you need help with anything? Chores? Cooking?
tunneler: Your back must hurt! I can rub it!
A boat for retirement! How exciting!
bush: What a lovely bush! So... green!
Wait. Did you just...? No, couldn't be.
You're hiding! That's okay! We all need hiding sometimes!
You're very good at being a bush!
aeronaut: You fly! That's amazing! So brave!
Is it scary up there? Or peaceful?
Can I ride? I'd hold on very tight!
onionboss: Foreman! That sounds like hard work!
You're shaped like... an onion! Cute!
Your miners are lucky to have you!
Don't work too hard! Take breaks!
astronaut: That suit looks heavy! You're so strong!
What do you see down there? Pretty things?
Be careful! The deep is mysterious!
conductor: All aboard! I love saying that!
The uniform is so sharp! So professional!
Trains are so romantic! Choo choo!
Where are we going? Is it fun?
shoewoman: Do you have anything in my size?
I love comfortable shoes! And pretty ones!
signguy: Your work is everywhere! So talented!
The colors are so vibrant! So cheerful!
Can you make me a sign? Something happy?
cobra: What a beautiful snake! So elegant!
Please don't bite me! I'm very nice!
The scales are so pretty! So shiny!
Mr. Whiskers is lucky to have you!
barrelgob: You live in a barrel! That's so cozy!
Is it warm? It looks warm! Like a hug!
Can I visit? I'll bring cookies!
You're like a hermit crab! So cute!
twins: Two of you! Double the friendship!
You look exactly alike! How fun!
Finish each other's sentences! So connected!
Do you ever switch places? For fun?
sunandmoon: The stars are so pretty! So mysterious!
You can tell fortunes? How exciting!
Am I going to have a good day? I hope so!
Your headdress is amazing! So tall!
